coverageNotes.columns: No freestanding columns are declared; wall ribs are engaged pilasters and remain part of the wall system.
coverageNotes.main-sign: The main sign is a procedural header plaque above the south arrival and contains no AI-rendered text.
coverageNotes.projectionMethod: The plan and elevation images are deterministic orthographic projections of the vertices in plans/function-concept-mesh.json, including chamfered opening geometry and non-rectangular prop silhouettes.
